title: Travelling out of New Orleans
summary: Asked about travel, Russ says he went to Mississippi for four or five weeks at a time but never lived elsewhere.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Can we stop with the Navy? Because I'm confused on something. Did you ever go out of town and play with bands?
That's all I ever did. Sam Morgan, I can tell you a lot of things.
No, I mean bands from Missouri or Mississippi. Did you ever move away from New Orleans?

Uh-huh. I had to go with it. Boy of them, I can't call his name now. Two-three boys had bands. Bass player from Mississippi. That's the name again. Uh-huh. What county's been? Gulfport, Biloxi, William O'Connor. Somebody else over there, actually. Well, that's a long time ago. Did you ever stay out of New Orleans for a long time? Well, I should travel.
You used to stay out of New Orleans for a long time. I should travel.
You used to stay out of New Orleans for a long time. I used to stay out of New Orleans for four or five weeks.
But you wouldn't stay in a certain town for like a half a year or something like that. Not that long.
You never lived in Jackson, Mississippi?
No, uh-uh. I went to Jackson, Mississippi. That's when I was playing in Jackson, Mississippi. Traveling with Robert Sullivan. You mentioned Stan Morgan.
